title: Hearing tech startup Legato emerges from stealth with $12M and a peek at its AI hearing glasses
summary: Legato was founded by Mehul Trivedi and Steve Romine, who bring extensive experience in wearables and hearing care from Bose, where Trivedi led the creation of Bose Frames and Romine ran the hearing aids division.
